nodes.label: Post-Purchase Delivery-Exception Assistant
nodes.rationale: The plan deliberately narrows the product to post-purchase delivery exceptions rather than a generic agent platform or replenishment system.

nodes.label: Deterministic Coordinator
nodes.rationale: Explicit code and policy determine routing and ordering so a language model cannot select or approve actions.

nodes.label: Bounded Strands Specialists
nodes.rationale: Specialists are constrained to evidence, explanation, and language drafts so their model output remains non-authoritative.

nodes.label: Named Human Approval
nodes.rationale: A named approval is the hard gate before a future write adapter can take an external action.

nodes.label: Dry-Run Write Adapter
nodes.rationale: Integrations begin in dry-run to prevent customer or financial risk while preserving explicit human approval.

nodes.label: API-Funded Development Continuity
nodes.rationale: The offline demo does not require an API key; any future credential use must be local, secret-free in source, cost-bounded, and have a testable fallback.

nodes.label: Deterministic Delivery Policy
nodes.rationale: Carrier states and explicit thresholds determine work instead of asking a language model to decide it.

nodes.label: strands_runtime.py Live Runner
nodes.rationale: The live runner is separate from the demo runner so deterministic policy testing does not depend on model credentials.
